description: This file implements the TestService class for the Rialto server manager, handling server lifecycle, state management, and request handling via a network server.

classes.name: TestService
classes.description: A class managing server lifecycle, request handling, and application state for the Rialto server manager.

methods.name: TestService
methods.description: Constructor initializing server with configuration and setting up request handling.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs the server, waiting until shutdown is signaled.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Signals the server to stop running.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the application state, managing active/inactive status and initiating applications as needed.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of an application.

methods.name: getAppInfo
methods.description: Returns connection info for a specified application.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets logging levels for the server.
